title: On Gradual AGI
description:
On Gradual AGI, First Edition. A framework for artificial general intelligence as a gradual, ongoing transformation rather than a single arrival: the Multi-Plateau Framework and the Unified Gradual AGI Model. The book follows how capability becomes realized change through availability, exposure and domain conditions, and how optimization, governance, participation, evidence and feedback shape that path. Every claim carries an explicit status, and the book states what would count against it.

The complete book is in book/On_Gradual_AGI.pdf. The archive also contains the online-edition source, citation metadata, the revision record, and Python code reproducing the calculations in Chapters 5, 6 and 9.

Online edition: champaignmagazine.github.io/on-gradual-agi
